summary: The static analysis reveals an Android application with a broad attack surface exposed through exported activities, debug mode, backup and cleartext traffic permissions, combined with code-level vulnerabilities such as insecure runtime execution, unfiltered WebView URLs, weak AES/ECB encryption, unrestricted file writes, and unchecked Base64 decoding. Risks are amplified when manifest-derived entry points (e.g., the vulnerable VulnWeb activity) interact with insecure code paths, creating exploitable data exfiltration or execution pathways.
top_risks: Unprotected exported activities allowing intent injection and data leakage
Cleartext network traffic enabling eavesdropping or man‑in‑the‑middle attacks
Runtime.exec surface in RootBeer exposing command execution, potentially to external input
WebView.loadUrl with unsanitized content allowing arbitrary URL loading and data leakage
Weak AES/ECB cipher usage compromising data confidentiality
correlations: Exported VulnWeb activity launches WebView.loadUrl with uncontrolled content; manifest allows exposure of activity and network usage
Debuggable build combined with Runtime.exec in RootBeer increases runtime tampering opportunities
Storage permissions plus FileOutputStream writes to shared/external directories enable data leakage via backups
Cleartext traffic allows sniffing of unsecured API requests potentially containing AES-encrypted data
allowBackup enabled allows adversaries to extract data written by FileOutputStream writes
vulnerability_candidates: android:exported="true" activities (MainActivity, InsecureCryptoActivity, VulnWeb) lacking permission checks
WebView.loadUrl(String) invoked with uncontrolled 'content' from VulnWeb.java
RootBeer.java executes Runtime.exec("/system/bin/grep -c root ..") with no input validation
FileOutputStream writes to external directories (e.g., /sdcard/...) without permission enforcement and backup export
recommended_next_steps: Disable android:debuggable="true" and set allowBackup="false" or secure backup rules
Restrict exported activities by adding android:exported="false" or protecting them with intent-filters/user permissions
Reject cleartext traffic by setting usesCleartextTraffic="false" and enforcing TLS for all network operations
Sanitize input before calling WebView.loadUrl and enforce a whitelist of allowed URLs
Replace AES/ECB mode with an authenticated cipher (e.g., AES/GCM/NoPadding) and securely manage keys, restrict FileOutputStream writes to internal app storage
